working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'T2' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature T2 cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T2 neuron (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).

justification: Authors name this early (0-24h APF) cluster T2; the cells are developing T2 neurons, so FBbt's immature form of the T2 neuron, added for this dataset (FBbt #2216, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature T2 neuron term (used until FBbt #2216 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch projects into a medulla column, where it forms a bushy, fine, arborization in medulla layer M9 and then projects through the rest of the medulla column, forming fine arborizations in M1, M2 and M5. The other branch forms a terminal arborization in lobula layer 3 that is much wider than a single column and has bleb-type terminal branches. It seems to be capable of cholinergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature/adult term; cells are 0-24h APF immature neurons.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053664 'immature T2 neuron' (exact match).
